MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 5

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 5

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 13

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 7

10. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 48

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 12
   C. 14
   D. 10

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

15. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

18. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

19. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 16

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

21. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 17

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

23. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
